name: nrk-subtitle-studio
description: Chrome extension that loads all NRK TV subtitles and shows them in a scrolling, time-synced overlay with optional Google Translate. Helpful for people who want to learn the Norwegian language.

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run clean:all && npm run build && node scripts/pack-zip.mjs && node scripts/pack-crx.mjs
